description: Installable stdio MCP server for evidence-readiness workflows: schema validation, claim audit, source coverage, quote-presence checks, and analysis prompt assembly. It routes evidence to human review; it does not provide legal, compliance, sanctions, financial, procurement, or factual-truth determinations.

tools.name: validate_memo
tools.description: Validate a strategic-risk memo against the agenda memo schema.

tools.name: audit_claims
tools.description: Audit claim-level evidence links, support levels, and unsupported claims.

tools.name: source_coverage
tools.description: Check whether an evidence pack covers required source categories.

tools.name: verify_quotes
tools.description: Check whether quoted fragments appear in caller-supplied source text.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: Assemble an evidence-disciplined analysis prompt for human review.

tools.name: validate_evidence
tools.description: Validate an evidence pack contract before handoff.

tools.name: score_output
tools.description: Score output readiness against evidence and policy quality gates.

tools.name: list_source_categories
tools.description: List source categories used for coverage planning.

boundaries: No legal, financial, compliance, investment, or trading advice.
